title: Tank Stars
description:
Are you ready for an action-packed 2D tank warfare? Welcome to Tank Stars, a battle tank game you can play with friends online and offline. Find the right shooting angle and unleash your iron force against your foe's war machines! Make the right shot quickly or you'll lose!

CARRY OUT BLITZ

Your mission is simple, Commander! In this turn-based multiplayer game, you take down another opponent's tanks before they take out yours. Remember, it's all about making the right shot quickly!
